review.conclusion_reason: The table confirms a revocation lead, but does not supply the later instrument's operative revoking words or effective date. Under the stated rules, operative status remains OPEN pending PLO 6688 at 53 FR 46871; formal revocation is reported by the table but not confirmed from the instrument. The asserted ending no later than 1988-12-31 is unsupported. T2 also fails because no accepted original of EO 1557 was read.
